## Changes

- Revert the 3D coverflow and centered row padding that created gaps and jitter. Keep a subtle focused-card lift and add a smooth moving backdrop transition.
- Keep quick-action icons focusable so Watchlist and Resume can be selected with the remote, while consuming the opening OK press.
- Display the remaining duration in white in the Continue Watching quick actions.

## Verification And Limitations

Debug unit tests and release lint passed locally. Remote focus and animation timing still need physical TV verification.
